attendance.title: Attendance report
attendance.footer: Times use each row's shift timezone. Daily overtime retains its existing calculation after actual late minutes. Overtime of at least 30 minutes per record is green and counted; smaller values are red and excluded as credits. Negative overtime shows a work-hour shortfall. Actual late (min) greater than 5 deducts a fixed 30 minutes, regardless of extra work or late approval; exactly 5 does not. Completed workdays below 8h 30m also deduct the missing worked minutes. Open attendance and nonworking days have no shortage deduction.
attendance.unknownOvertime: Total excludes {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} with unknown overtime from credits; known late and completed-day shortage deductions still apply.
